# Pre-Wedding Customs

> Marriage Rites (Jiali, the Rites of Festivity) / Pre-Wedding Customs · 15 entries

The whole body of pre-wedding custom, from negotiation and betrothal to the preparation of the trousseau: matchmaking, horoscope matching, betrothal gifts, date selection and dowry.
